item: merge-writes scan: .replace fragments of the prefix, aliases and partials of execute and the helpers
summary: The two lows the #1395 check left for the next PR. A .replace on a pass-through parameter is refused when the replaced text is a fragment of main. or temp. An alias of execute or of a helper (ex = con.execute, ex = run, through getattr too) is followed, and an execute method or helper used as any other value (partial(run, con), map(con.execute, rows)) is a problem. 14 planted cases, each shown to fail only on its clause by switching the clause off.
